It includes the first v[0]-controlled shifts, subtracted/swp/s2/t1 tuple, Step0 codec symbol, and the matching reverse decode requirement. It excludes APPLY_COUT_K/FOLD/FFG tuning, early-sum freeing, local square add/sub, codec width, schedule geometry, deep-strip table mutation, and any census.
composite_card.mechanism: A prospective f-term transport cannot infer safety merely because a term is high-positioned or because SCHED_J2[0]=256. apply_shifted_hi_term is a modular update: a selected controlled term can create a carry or mod-p correction whose low bits alter v[0], then alter i=0 t1/s2/subtracted and the Step0 dialog symbol before any hypothetical restore. The discriminator builds a bit-accurate classical reference of the selected b_hi term and first divstep, and asks whether deleting/defering that term preserves the entire i=0 control tuple and post-step value under the same lambda/input relation. This is a necessary condition for a later paired transport, not itself a deletion.

The compared control tuple is (t1, s2, subtracted, swp) plus resulting active v/u state and exact Step0 encoding. Any difference is observable state, not a harmless top-bit difference.
